brand_facts: Skyline Capital (skylinecapital.io) is a boutique business brokerage and M&A advisory firm for MSMEs and SMEs, based in Mohali, Punjab, working with buyers, investors and lenders across India. It helps founders and business owners sell their business through a confidential, structured process (valuation, confidential teaser, a screened buyer list, negotiation through to closing); helps buyers and companies find, evaluate and acquire a business; helps businesses raise equity or debt funding; and helps owners franchise, rent or lease their business to grow. Supporting work includes business valuation, information memorandums and pitch decks, business plans, financial models, due diligence and data-room support, and term sheet / LOI advice. Its process is diagnose, prepare, match, negotiate, close; disclosures are shared only under NDA; pricing is MSME-friendly and its incentives are aligned with the client's outcome. It is not a property or real-estate agency and does not offer loans itself.
